title: Research: prove QQ16 parking bounds and exact row-division depth with the global-root cutoff
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/qq16-root-cutoff-parking/`. PR #4865 proves a parked-volume law at the fixed cutoff 356 and explicitly leaves changing root descriptors open (its Open next question 2). The actual historical QQ16 backend stops at `w < 73 or w^1000 < d`, where d is the global root-width descriptor. This package keeps that dependence and proves a uniform envelope with `T_d=max(73,ceil(d^(1/1000)))`:

`H_d(w)=Theta((w/T_d)^s)` for every nonterminal width, with constants independent of both parameters. Consequently the diagonal recurrence has `H_d(d)=Theta(d^(999s/1000))`, where s is the predecessor's existing moment root. The explicit constants and proof are in `research/qq16-root-cutoff-parking/PROOF.md`.

The maximum rank-48 path gives the exact selected-C row-division depth D. An independent inverse characterization uses `B_1=T_d`, `B_(j+1)=73 ceil(B_j/48)`. All selected-C divisions are positive and exact iff `F^D` divides the positive incoming rows, where `F=14336 Gamma`. At the historical `d=isqrt(2^16949)`, `T_d=356` and D=13997, versus the cutoff-free sufficient depth 13999.

This is a **scoped proof with exact finite corroboration**, not installed stock reduction, a complete physical cost comparison, or a κ step. The physical term retains `N Gamma v H_d(w)`; v is not held constant as d grows. No admitted RootPlan with w=d is constructed. The fixed-cutoff predecessor remains correct. Candidate-only nonchild/shell/control work, actual stock/layout admission, native/precision/restoration and outer obligations remain open. The selected #5413 result is unchanged.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3 on Linux, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-root-cutoff-parking --check-only

python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qq16-root-cutoff-parking --check-source-history
```

All pass. Scientific status: `PASS_QQ16_ROOT_CUTOFF_PARKING`; wrapper: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Normal and optimized modes compare the complete typed deterministic receipt.

Evidence: 81930 table entries; 70 independent breadth censuses; 584 rank/residue checks; 30 strict-power boundaries; inverse-depth agreement; 85 unchanged-source node-method and 304 child-method cases; 12 rejection controls. Exact stock and Gamma/volume arithmetic is checked at Gamma=1, 2, 7. The source methods execute over explicitly substituted integer descriptor primitives, **not physical Tape/Count or native execution**. The histogram is a cited, authenticated premise; its census and numerical moment root were not replayed.

Committed-byte/history checks cover all 13 package/input files. Official export/check passes; both direct modes pass with empty PATH in a read-only Git-free export, with all 14 files unchanged. A corrupt source input is rejected before execution. Direct export runs took about 2 seconds each, with maximum child RSS 48220 KiB; these are verification-resource observations, not algorithm benchmarks.

No production payload, complete ordinary/outer or selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, hosted CI, independent human review or proof-kernel verification was run.
